title: [AI] fix(schedules): allow auto-posting to run again the same day
issueTitle: [Bug]: Automatic scheduled transaction posting a day late— Desktop 26.9.0
why: The bug depends on today's date, the time zone and the schedule's due-date timing (it posts a day late, on the Windows desktop app), so no fixed visible fact can be checked the same way on every run without dates or a time zone.
